data.long_description:
DAMAC Bay by Cavalli offers a prime location in the dynamic Dubai Harbour, with seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road for fast connectivity across the city. Just a 30-minute drive to Downtown Dubai and Dubai International Airport (DXB), convenience is at your doorstep. The Dubai Harbour Cruise Terminal is also just a short walk away.

For families, top attractions like Ain Dubai, Jumeirah Beach, Aquaventure Waterpark, and The Lost Chambers Aquarium on Palm Jumeirah are just moments away.

Adventure seekers can reach Skydive Dubai for tandem jumps, indoor skydiving, and gyrocopter flights, as well as Emirates Golf Club, all within a 15-minute drive.

As a Cavalli-branded development, DAMAC Bay offers a host of exclusive amenities, including a Cavalli Private Club and a spectacular glass water bridge adorned with Cavalli designs. Residents will enjoy direct beach access and a lively promenade for leisure and relaxation.
